name: Linear
author: Jacob Vincent-Mink
description: Adds bounded assigned issue, comment, state-change, and due-work context from Linear GraphQL.

categories.label: Assigned issues
categories.description: Recently updated non-completed issues assigned to you.

categories.label: Mentions and comments
categories.description: Recent comments on your assigned issues, including detected profile mentions.

categories.label: State changes
categories.description: Recorded workflow-state transitions on your assigned issues.

categories.label: Due and overdue work
categories.description: Assigned issues due today, soon, or overdue.

setup.summary: Uses a read-capable Linear personal API key. OmaDigest sends it only to Linear's GraphQL endpoint.

fields.label: Personal API key
fields.description: Create a read-capable key in Linear Settings → Account → Security & access.
